observations: Photo 0 and photo 2 show the same metal assembly: a transmission bolted to a transfer case, with an engine's oil pan and wiring harness visible above it, sitting on wet/muddy concrete.
A green paint dot, a chalk mark 'CA' and another chalk mark are visible on the transfer case housing in photos 0 and 2 - these look like yard inventory marks, not manufacturer tags.
No manufacturer plate, part-number tag, or VIN sticker is legible in any photo.

Photo 1 shows a wide yard view with several other engines/transmissions stacked on the ground and a person's leg/boot visible, confirming this is a used-parts dealer's lot, not a single private seller's garage.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI / GEARUP INC.' appears on all three photos, indicating a dealer/reseller listing rather than an individual's own photos.
Visible surface rust on the exhaust flange and some bolts in photo 0/2.
No fluid, no odometer, no diagnostic screen, and no running/test footage is shown in any photo.
Seller's new message is a verbal reassertion only; no new photo, video, or document was provided.

A short video of the unit being spun by hand or bench-tested showing smooth rotation and no knock
Photo of the input/output shafts and internal splines for wear or corrosion
Import or clearing documentation showing a single consistent origin
Photo of all wiring harness connectors to confirm completeness
response.reason: The seller's reply adds only words, not new photographic evidence, so none of the prior verdicts change; the item remains priceable only at worst case as an unverified-fitment, untested used transmission/transfer case assembly.
